section_summary.extract_value: This section states hypotheses that women dissatisfied with their appearance will report lower sexual function and satisfaction and higher sexual distress, whereas higher body appreciation will be associated with greater sexual satisfaction, better sexual function, and less sexuality-related distress. It also hypothesizes that body appreciation increases with age and that while sexual function and satisfaction tend to decline with age, women experience less sexual distress. Finally, it hypothesizes that body appreciation will moderate the negative effects of age on distress and on sexual satisfaction; no studies are labeled (e.g., 'Study 1') and no sample, methods, or statistical values are reported in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: Based on previous research (Berman, Berman, Miles, Pollets, & Powell, 2003; Pauls et al., 2008; Weavers & Byers, 2013), we expected that women who were dissatisfied with their general appearanceandthatofspecificbodypartwouldreportlowersexual function and satisfaction, and higher sexual distress compared to thosewhoarecontentwiththeirappearance. Converselyandinline with Satinsky et al. (2012), we hypothesized that women with increased body appreciation would experience more sexual satisfaction, better sexual function, and less sexuality-related distress. With regard to the aging process, we expected that, as women mature and accrue life experience, they also develop higher appreciation for their bodies. We also hypothesized that, while sexual function and satisfaction tend to decline with age, women are less distressed about their sexual lives. Lastly, we expected that body appreciation would moderate the negative relationship between age and distress, such that the attenuating effect of age on distress would be stronger among women with high body appreciation. Similarly,weexpectedthatbodyappreciation wouldmoderatethe deleterious effect of age on sexual satisfaction in such way that itis weaker among those who exhibit higher appreciation for their body.
